source.title: Open problems and conjectures in finite fields

trace.notes: Normalized the input as a zbMATH resolver URL with identifier 953225. Direct fetch of https://zbmath.org/953225 returned a blocked_or_challenged Cloudflare 403 response, so the zbMATH REST API was used only for identity metadata.

zbMATH API metadata identified the exact work as Open problems and conjectures in finite fields by Gary L. Mullen and Igor Shparlinski, DOI 10.1017/CBO9780511525988.021, pages 243-268 in Finite Fields and Applications.

Recovery attempts followed the DOI, Crossref resource and link fields, OpenAlex by DOI, the Cambridge Core landing page, and exact-title searches for PDF, Problem 1, and Conjecture 1. The Cambridge candidate exposed only metadata, abstract, and preview text with a Get access restriction; OpenAlex reported is_oa=false, best_oa_location=null, and no repository full text; search candidates were the same Cambridge restricted source or unrelated citing works.

No readable exact-work PDF or full HTML source containing the technical problem statements was recovered. Per source adequacy and no-new-facts gates, no questions were extracted from resolver metadata, abstracts, search snippets, or citing papers.
Saved the JSON result to outputs/parse-paper/zbmath-953225.json and outputs/latest.json.
